runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Use only the measured scale, camera, round-tray relationships, light distribution and restrained palette. Regenerate every scene pixel and never reproduce identifiable background objects, beverage recipes, text, logos or exact shadow shapes.

allowed_style_features: one exact right-front beverage at modest scale
one left-front drink and one rear-center carafe as quiet companions
one complete round dark-wood tray on a white circular table
hard architectural daylight in the far room
open shade and broad window bounce over the tray
forbidden_copy_features: identifiable heater, plants, lamp or furniture

pov_modes: slightly-above observational cafe still life with room context
asymmetry_sources: unequal vessel heights and an off-center triangular grouping
micro_moments: a small shared cafe order encountered before anyone reaches for a drink

tone_contract.background_plane: a lived-in warm-neutral room with hard linear sunlight kept behind the foreground table
tone_contract.color_bias: wood warmth remains local to the tray while table whites, glass, ceramic and matcha keep independent color
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: small broken glass-edge responses and rolled daylight with no clipped white saucer

composition.shot_type: environment-first cafe observation with one small related tray group
composition.camera_angle: slightly above at approximately thirty to thirty-six degrees downward
composition.camera_height: approximately one hundred forty to one hundred seventy-five centimeters with the camera stepped back
composition.horizon_visibility: room and empty table register before the small tray group
composition.depth_of_field: all tray items, rims and contacts resolve; distant room detail loses fine definition
composition.alignment: a small off-center unequal three-point rhythm surrounded by dominant room and table breathing space

lighting.type: direct architectural sun in the far room plus open shade and broad window bounce over the tray
lighting.direction: back-right daylight crosses the far floor while soft neutral bounce reaches the foreground from the same side
lighting.intensity: bright far-room field with a quieter foreground exposure
lighting.contrast: visible separation between sunlit room, white table and light-absorbing dark tray
lighting.shadow: hard architectural bands stay in the far plane; vessel contacts remain dense and attached with broader soft falloff
lighting.highlight_control: glass rims and white ceramic roll below clipping; the tray shows only narrow broken responses

color.temperature: warm-neutral daylight without an amber filter
color.saturation: restrained room and wood with the exact user beverage color protected
color.contrast: weighted lower mids, separated neutral highlights and a soft shoulder
color.black_point: deep neutral chocolate-brown with visible tray grain

scene.surface: one white circular table supporting one complete round dark oiled-wood tray spanning only 0.44-0.50 of frame width
scene.background: an original quiet room with low-detail architecture and no identifiable A6 furnishing
props: one complete round dark oiled-wood serving tray
scene.texture: matte dark wood grain, finite glass thickness, soft condensation, ceramic glaze and modest social-photo acuity

capture.look: natural quiet social photograph whose scale, spacing and light feel considered without looking arranged
capture.realism: one camera, one exposure and one physical daylight system connect room, table, tray and every vessel
capture.grain: faint low-contrast luminance texture with finite twelve-to-sixteen-megapixel acuity

hard_lock: user beverage identity, recipe, color and cold serving state
selected container design reconstructed rather than pasted
one complete round tray 0.44-0.50 of frame width and no more than 0.31 frame height

prompt_blocks.input_roles: Image one supplies exact beverage identity and serving evidence. When present, the sanitized A6 scene hint supplies only low-frequency camera, scale, tray relationships, light distribution and palette.
prompt_blocks.composition: ENVIRONMENT-FIRST SCALE LOCK: the complete tray cluster occupies at most 0.50 frame width and 0.31 frame height. The exact drink stays 0.13-0.15 frame width and 0.15-0.18 frame height. Keep 0.50-0.60 room-and-table release; when uncertain, step back and render every foreground object smaller.
prompt_blocks.look: Direct architectural sunlight remains in the distant room while the foreground tray sits in open shade and broad window bounce. Dark wood absorbs light but keeps restrained grain and depth.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Reconstruct the exact user beverage inside the selected container design with new perspective, refraction, highlights, contact and shadow. Follow only the final target brand contract and invent no text or mark.
prompt_blocks.negative: No oversized drink, close-up tray, rectangular tray, cropped tray, duplicated exact beverage, fourth vessel, isolated subject, identifiable copied room object, amber wash, pasted boundary, cutout halo, false text or uniform sharpness.

quality_gates.logo_text: no visible logo or text unless an explicit target brand contract separately authorizes it
quality_gates.product_identity: exactly one user beverage remains recognizable by recipe, color, ice and serving state after physical reconstruction
quality_gates.preset_adherence: exact body width 0.13-0.15, height 0.15-0.18, complete tray width 0.44-0.50 and height at most 0.31, three-item relationship and 0.50-0.60 meaningful release
quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject oversized subject, rectangular or cropped tray, pasted cup edge, detached contact, repeated source pixels, wrong serving state, invented text, amber veil or copied background object

failure_recovery: return the exact drink to 0.13-0.15 frame width and 0.15-0.18 frame height
restore one complete round tray at 0.44-0.50 frame width and at most 0.31 frame height
restore the left drink and rear carafe as quiet related companions
rebuild the selected container under the target light instead of preserving its source boundary
restore a darker open-shade foreground and hard daylight only in the far room
